what: Hand-maintained index of the dated JLC file sets under engineering/a7/jlc-package/. scripts/a7_jlc_package.py reads it, verifies each set's SHA256SUMS and board identities, and names the current set on the generated owner page. A set is never edited after it is recorded; a newer set supersedes it.

statuses.HISTORICAL_SUPERSEDED: Bound to board identities that are no longer current. Kept byte-for-byte with its approval evidence; not an upload choice.
statuses.REVIEW_ONLY_NOT_FOR_ORDER: Bound to the current board identities for review. Not an upload set while the revision-specific owner prototype-route approval or the external order-form checks are open.
statuses.PROTOTYPE_UPLOAD_APPROVED: Bound to the current identities and to an owner prototype-route approval recorded in qualification/records.json. Still not a manufacturing release.

sets.settings: controller 1.6 mm 4-layer, LED leaf 0.6 mm 2-layer (A5 leaf file), power adapter 1.6 mm 2-layer
sets.approval_scope: The 2026-11-12/13 owner prototype-route approvals in qualification/approvals/ bind these old identities only; they do not carry to any later board.
sets.superseded_by_change: PR #88 (0.8 mm rigid FR-4 redesign, merged 6f6e8ea): new controller and LED leaf boards
sets.note: The panel BOM/CPL bytes here equal the current panels/ BOM/CPL because the 0.8 mm redesign kept every placement, part and designator; the Gerber zips are from the old boards and are not current.
